question: In the stage of immature B lymphocyte:

options.opa: There have not been rearrangements in the light chain yet.
options.opb: IgM is expressed on the surface.
options.opc: Substitutes of the light chain are expressed.
options.opd: There is differentiation in response to antigens.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: yet -> IgM is expressed on the surface -> 70%
analysis: In the stage of immature B lymphocyte, there have been rearrangements in the light chain but IgM is expressed on the surface before the substitution of the light chain. Differentiation in response to antigens occurs at a later stage.
